verses.sloka: सुग्रीवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा हेतुमत् परम अर्थवित् ।प्रतिजग्राह काकुत्स्थो हनूमन्तम् अथ अब्रवीत् ॥६-३-१॥।।
verses.transliteration: sugrīvasya vacaḥ śrutvā hetumat parama arthavit ।pratijagrāha kākutstho hanūmantam atha abravīt ॥6-3-1॥।।

translations.english: Rama the scion of Kakuthsa dynasty having accepted the wellmeaning words of Sugriva, who spoke the truth with deep understanding, turned to Hanuman and said.

verses.sloka: तरसा सेतु बन्धेन सागर उच्चोषणेन वा ।सर्वथा सुसमर्थो अस्मि सागरस्य अस्य लन्घने ॥६-३-२॥।।
verses.transliteration: tarasā setu bandhena sāgara uccoṣaṇena vā ।sarvathā susamartho asmi sāgarasya asya langhane ॥6-3-2॥।।

translations.english: "By austerity or by drying up the ocean or by any other means, I am capable of crossing the ocean."
translations.hindi: है शोभयन्ति पुरी लङ्काँ रावणस्य दुरात्मनः । अयुत रक्षेसासत्र पृषद्वार समाश्रतस्‌

verses.sloka: कति दुर्गाणि दुर्गाया लंकायास् तद् ब्रवीहि मे ।ज्ञातुम् इच्चामि तत् सर्वम् दर्शनाद् इव वानर ॥६-३-३॥।।
verses.transliteration: kati durgāṇi durgāyā laṁkāyās tad bravīhi me ।jñātum iccāmi tat sarvam darśanād iva vānara ॥6-3-3॥।।

translations.english: "O Vanara How many forts are in Lanka? You may tell me whatever you have seen. I wish to know all that."

verses.sloka: बलस्य परिमाणम् च द्वार दुर्ग क्रियाम् अपि ।गुप्ति कर्म च लंकाया रक्षसाम् सदनानि च ॥६-३-४॥।।
verses.transliteration: balasya parimāṇam ca dvāra durga kriyām api ।gupti karma ca laṁkāyā rakṣasām sadanāni ca ॥6-3-4॥।।

translations.english: "Tell me in detail about the strength and size of the army, the number of gateways that are difficult to enter, the way in which the entrances have been protected by the rakshasas, and their dwellings in Lanka. Indeed you are aware of all aspects and are also capable."

verses.sloka: यथा सुखम् यथावच् च लंकायाम् असि दृष्टवान् ।सरम् आचक्ष्व तत्त्वेन सर्वथा कुशलो हि असि ॥६-३-५॥।।
verses.transliteration: yathā sukham yathāvac ca laṁkāyām asi dṛṣṭavān ।saram ācakṣva tattvena sarvathā kuśalo hi asi ॥6-3-5॥।।

translations.english: "Tell me in detail about the strength and size of the army, the number of gateways that are difficult to enter, the way in which the entrances have been protected by the rakshasas, and their dwellings in Lanka. Indeed you are aware of all aspects and are also capable."

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा रामस्य वचनम् हनूमान् मारुत आत्मजः ।वाक्यम् वाक्यविदाम् श्रेष्ठो रामम् पुनर् अथ अब्रवीत् ॥६-३-६॥।।
verses.transliteration: śrutvā rāmasya vacanam hanūmān māruta ātmajaḥ ।vākyam vākyavidām śreṣṭho rāmam punar atha abravīt ॥6-3-6॥।।

translations.english: Hanuman the son of Maruti, the foremost among those who are good at speech, having heard Rama's words again said to Rama.

verses.sloka: श्रूयताम् सर्वम् आख्यास्ये दुर्ग कर्म विधानतः ।गुप्ता पुरी यथा लंका रक्षिता च यथा बलैः ॥६-३-७॥।।
verses.transliteration: śrūyatām sarvam ākhyāsye durga karma vidhānataḥ ।guptā purī yathā laṁkā rakṣitā ca yathā balaiḥ ॥6-3-7॥।।

translations.english: "I will relate the way in which the city of Lanka is fortified, the way in which it is protected by secret forces, everything you wish to hear."

verses.sloka: राक्षसाश्च यथा स्निग्धा रावणस्य च तेजसा ।पराम् समृद्धिम् लंकायाः सागरस्य च भीमताम् ॥६-३-८॥।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasāśca yathā snigdhā rāvaṇasya ca tejasā ।parām samṛddhim laṁkāyāḥ sāgarasya ca bhīmatām ॥6-3-8॥।।

translations.english: Hanuman, the foremost of the vanaras said that he will truly point out everything in Lanka:"Ravana's power, the affection of rakshasas to Ravana, his prosperity, the terrifying ocean, the divisions of the army such as chariots, elephants, horses and soldiers."

verses.sloka: विभागम् च बल ओघस्य निर्देशम् वाहनस्य च ।एवमुक्त्वा कपिश्रेष्ठः कथयामास तत्ववित् ॥६-३-९॥।।
verses.transliteration: vibhāgam ca bala oghasya nirdeśam vāhanasya ca ।evamuktvā kapiśreṣṭhaḥ kathayāmāsa tatvavit ॥6-3-9॥।।

translations.english: Hanuman, the foremost of the vanaras said that he will truly point out everything in Lanka:"Ravana's power, the affection of rakshasas to Ravana, his prosperity, the terrifying ocean, the divisions of the army such as chariots, elephants, horses and soldiers."

verses.sloka: प्रहृष्टा मुदिता लंका मत्त द्विप समाकुला ।महती रथ सम्पूर्णा रक्षो गण समाकुला ॥६-३-१०॥।।
verses.transliteration: prahṛṣṭā muditā laṁkā matta dvipa samākulā ।mahatī ratha sampūrṇā rakṣo gaṇa samākulā ॥6-3-10॥।।

translations.english: "The people in the vast island of Lanka are very delighted. Lanka is filled with chariots and innumerable rakshasas."

verses.sloka: दृढ बद्ध कवाटानि महापरिघवन्ति च ।चत्वारि विपुलान्यस्या द्वाराणि सुमहान्ति ॥६-३-११॥।।
verses.transliteration: dṛḍha baddha kavāṭāni mahāparighavanti ca ।catvāri vipulānyasyā dvārāṇi sumahānti ॥6-3-11॥।।

translations.english: "Lanka is endowed with lofty wide courtyards, entrances with doors that are fixed with metal fixtures and large iron bars."

verses.sloka: तत्रेषूपयन्त्राणि बलवन्ति महान्ति च ।आगतम् पर सैन्यम् तैस् तत्र प्रतिनिवार्यते ॥६-३-१२॥।।
verses.transliteration: tatreṣūpayantrāṇi balavanti mahānti ca ।āgatam para sainyam tais tatra pratinivāryate ॥6-3-12॥।।

translations.english: "The doors are fitted with powerful machines which retaliate by discharging darts and stones on the enemy's army and kill them."

verses.sloka: द्वारेषु सम्स्कृता भीमाः काल आयस मयाः शिताः ।शतशो रोचिता वीरैः शतघ्न्यो रक्षसाम् गणैः ॥६-३-१३॥।।
verses.transliteration: dvāreṣu samskṛtā bhīmāḥ kāla āyasa mayāḥ śitāḥ ।śataśo rocitā vīraiḥ śataghnyo rakṣasām gaṇaiḥ ॥6-3-13॥।।

translations.english: At the entrances are troops of terrific looking guards kept ready with a hundred sharpened stones studded with iron spikes.

verses.sloka: सौवर्णः च महाम्स् तस्याः प्राकारो दुष्प्रधर्षणः ।मणि विद्रुम वैदूर्य मुक्ता विचरित अन्तरः ॥६-३-१४॥।।
verses.transliteration: sauvarṇaḥ ca mahāms tasyāḥ prākāro duṣpradharṣaṇaḥ ।maṇi vidruma vaidūrya muktā vicarita antaraḥ ॥6-3-14॥।।

translations.english: "Its lofty golden boundary wall encrusted here and there with gems, corals, Vaiduryas and pearls is difficult to assail."

verses.sloka: सर्वतः च महाभीमाः शीत तोया महाशुभाः ।अगाधा ग्राहवत्यः च परिखा मीन सेविताः ॥६-३-१५॥।।
verses.transliteration: sarvataḥ ca mahābhīmāḥ śīta toyā mahāśubhāḥ ।agādhā grāhavatyaḥ ca parikhā mīna sevitāḥ ॥6-3-15॥।।

translations.english: All round it (boundary wall) are very splendid moats filled with frighteningcold water inhabited by fish and crocodiles.

verses.sloka: द्वारेषु तासाम् चत्वारः सम्क्रमाः परम आयताः ।यन्त्रैर् उपेता बहुभिर् महद्भिर् दृढ सम्धिभिः ॥६-३-१६॥।।
verses.transliteration: dvāreṣu tāsām catvāraḥ samkramāḥ parama āyatāḥ ।yantrair upetā bahubhir mahadbhir dṛḍha samdhibhiḥ ॥6-3-16॥।।

translations.english: At the entrance of the gateways around the moats are four road ways. Huge engines are fixed to move the bridges when people approach. There are rows of houses (for the guards) at the gateways.

verses.sloka: त्रायन्ते सम्क्रमास् तत्र पर सैन्य आगमे सति ।यन्त्रैस् तैर् अवकीर्यन्ते परिखासु समन्ततः ॥६-३-१७॥।।
verses.transliteration: trāyante samkramās tatra para sainya āgame sati ।yantrais tair avakīryante parikhāsu samantataḥ ॥6-3-17॥।।

translations.english: "When the enemy arrives, the engines all over the moats lift the bridges making entry impossible for enemy armies."

verses.sloka: एकस् त्व् अकम्प्यो बलवान् सम्क्रमः सुमहादृढः ।काञ्चनैर् बहुभिः स्तम्भैर् वेदिकाभिः च शोभितः ॥६-३-१८॥।।
verses.transliteration: ekas tv akampyo balavān samkramaḥ sumahādṛḍhaḥ ।kāñcanair bahubhiḥ stambhair vedikābhiḥ ca śobhitaḥ ॥6-3-18॥।।

translations.english: "One of the road ways is very strong and steady, shining with unshakeable golden pillars and altars."

verses.sloka: स्वयम् प्रकृति सम्पन्नो युयुत्सू राम रावणः ।उत्थितः च अप्रमत्तः च बलानाम् अनुदर्शने ॥६-३-१९॥।।
verses.transliteration: svayam prakṛti sampanno yuyutsū rāma rāvaṇaḥ ।utthitaḥ ca apramattaḥ ca balānām anudarśane ॥6-3-19॥।।

translations.english: "O Rama Ravana, who is hostile in his intentions, assuming his natural tendency which is eagerness to combat, is always very alert and looks after the army."

verses.sloka: लंका पुरी निरालम्बा देव दुर्गा भय आवहा ।न अदेयम् पार्वतम् वन्यम् कृत्रिमम् च चतुर् विधम् ॥६-३-२०॥।।
verses.transliteration: laṁkā purī nirālambā deva durgā bhaya āvahā ।na adeyam pārvatam vanyam kṛtrimam ca catur vidham ॥6-3-20॥।।

translations.english: "Lanka is difficult to access even for devatas located on high peaks of the mountain. It is fierce to onlookers, surrounded by four kinds of forts, like rivers, mountains, forests and artificial fortresses."

verses.sloka: स्थिता पारे समुद्रस्य दूर पारस्य राघव ।नौ पथः च अपि न अस्ति अत्र निरादेशः च सर्वतः ॥६-३-२१॥।।
verses.transliteration: sthitā pāre samudrasya dūra pārasya rāghava ।nau pathaḥ ca api na asti atra nirādeśaḥ ca sarvataḥ ॥6-3-21॥।।

translations.english: "O Raghava Lanka is located on the other shore of the ocean. Passage through the sea is not possible. It is away from all and there is nothing around."

verses.sloka: शैल अग्रे रचिता दुर्गा सा पूर् देव पुर उपमा ।वाजि वारण सम्पूर्णा लंका परम दुर्जया ॥६-३-२२॥।।
verses.transliteration: śaila agre racitā durgā sā pūr deva pura upamā ।vāji vāraṇa sampūrṇā laṁkā parama durjayā ॥6-3-22॥।।

translations.english: "It is inaccessible like the abode of devatas as it is on the peak of the mountain. It is difficult to conquer for any one as it is full of horses and elephants."

verses.sloka: परिघाः च शतघ्न्यः च यन्त्राणि विविधानि च ।शोभयन्ति पुरीम् लंकाम् रावणस्य दुरात्मनः ॥६-३-२३॥।।
verses.transliteration: parighāḥ ca śataghnyaḥ ca yantrāṇi vividhāni ca ।śobhayanti purīm laṁkām rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ ॥6-3-23॥।।

translations.english: "Evil minded Ravana's city of Lanka is shining with moats and missiles of many kinds and machinery."

verses.sloka: अयुतम् रक्षसाम् अत्र पश्चिम द्वारम् आश्रितम् ।शूल हस्ता दुराधर्षाः सर्वे खड्ग अग्र योधिनः ॥६-३-२४॥।।
verses.transliteration: ayutam rakṣasām atra paścima dvāram āśritam ।śūla hastā durādharṣāḥ sarve khaḍga agra yodhinaḥ ॥6-3-24॥।।

translations.english: "There(in Lanka) ten thousand warriors are garrisoned at the eastern gate way holding tridents, and those who are unassailable in war stand in front with swords."

verses.sloka: नियुतम् रक्षसाम् अत्र दक्षिण द्वारम् आश्रितम् ।चतुर् अन्गेण सैन्येन योधास् तत्र अपि अनुत्तमाः ॥६-३-२५॥।।
verses.transliteration: niyutam rakṣasām atra dakṣiṇa dvāram āśritam ।catur angeṇa sainyena yodhās tatra api anuttamāḥ ॥6-3-25॥।।

translations.english: At the southern gate also one lakh of rakshasas are garrisoned with four divisions of army. They are also the best warriors.
translations.hindi: उन लोगों के हाथ में तिशूल रहता है । ये बड़े दुधर्ण हैं श्रौर सव के सब तलवारों से लड़ने वाले हैं। दक्षिण द्वार पर एक लाख राक्षस सेनिक रहते हैं

verses.sloka: प्रयुतम् रक्षसाम् अत्र पूर्व द्वारम् समाश्रितम् ।चर्म खड्ग धराः सर्वे तथा सर्व अस्त्र कोविदाः ॥६-३-२६॥।।
verses.transliteration: prayutam rakṣasām atra pūrva dvāram samāśritam ।carma khaḍga dharāḥ sarve tathā sarva astra kovidāḥ ॥6-3-26॥।।

translations.english: At the western gate are garrisoned ten lakhs of rakshasas wearing shields of skin and holding swords. They are knowledgeable in several weapons.
translations.hindi: हि इनक साथ साथ चतुरङ्गिणी सेना रहती हे ओर जो सैनिक वहाँ हैं, वे भी बड़े प्रवीण लड़ने वाले हैं। पश्चिम द्वार पर दस लाख राक्षस रहते हैं

verses.sloka: न्यर्बुदम् रक्षसाम् अत्र उत्तर द्वारम् आश्रितम् ।रथिनः च अश्व वाहाः च कुल पुत्राः सुपूजिताः ॥६-३-२७॥।।
verses.transliteration: nyarbudam rakṣasām atra uttara dvāram āśritam ।rathinaḥ ca aśva vāhāḥ ca kula putrāḥ supūjitāḥ ॥6-3-27॥।।

translations.english: At the northern gate(of Lanka) are garrisoned one hundred crores of rakshasas constituting, charioteers, horse riding and elephant riding ogres born of noble families, respected and trustworthy (for Ravana).
translations.hindi: ये सब ढाल तलवारधारी हैं और अस्ना के चलाने में प्रवीण हें । एक अरब राक्षस उत्तर हार पर रहते है

verses.sloka: शतम् शत सहस्राणाम् मध्यमम् गुल्मम् आश्रितम् ।यातु धाना दुराधर्षाः साग्र कोटिः च रक्षसाम् ॥६-३-२८॥।।
verses.transliteration: śatam śata sahasrāṇām madhyamam gulmam āśritam ।yātu dhānā durādharṣāḥ sāgra koṭiḥ ca rakṣasām ॥6-3-28॥।।

translations.english: "Hundreds and thousands of warriors who are unassailable are collected in the center(of Lanka) in multitudes of crores."

verses.sloka: ते मया सम्क्रमा भग्नाः परिखाः च अवपूरिताः ।दग्धा च नगरी लंका प्राकाराः च अवसादिताः ॥६-३-२९॥।।
verses.transliteration: te mayā samkramā bhagnāḥ parikhāḥ ca avapūritāḥ ।dagdhā ca nagarī laṁkā prākārāḥ ca avasāditāḥ ॥6-3-29॥।।

translations.english: "I have destroyed some of those roadways, even filled up the moats, burnt parts of the city of Lanka, smashed the boundary walls and killed part of the powerful army."

verses.sloka: बलैकदेशः क्षपितो राक्षसानाम् महात्मनाम् ।येन केन तु मार्गेण तराम वरुण आलयम् ॥६-३-३०॥।।
verses.transliteration: balaikadeśaḥ kṣapito rākṣasānām mahātmanām ।yena kena tu mārgeṇa tarāma varuṇa ālayam ॥6-3-30॥।।

translations.english: "If by whatever means the passage of ocean can be crossed by vanaras it can be taken for granted that the city of Lanka is destroyed."
translations.hindi: दग्धा च नगरी सङ्का प्राकाराश्चावसादिताः ! | बलेकदेशः ज्ञपितो रात्तसानां स्महास्मनाम्‌ ॥ ३०) मैंने लंका जला डाली है ओर लंका का परकोटा गिरा दिआ है । मैंने महाकाय बाले राज्ञसों की एक चोयियायी सेना . . मार डाली है

verses.sloka: हता इति नगरी लंकाम् वानरैर् अवधार्यताम् ।अङ्गदो द्विविदो मैन्दो जाम्बवान् पनसो नलः ॥६-३-३१॥।।
verses.transliteration: hatā iti nagarī laṁkām vānarair avadhāryatām ।aṅgado dvivido maindo jāmbavān panaso nalaḥ ॥6-3-31॥।।

translations.english: "Raghava What do we have to do with the rest of the army when Angada, Dwivida, Mainda, Jambavan, Panasa, Nala and the chief of the army Nila are there? Reaching Ravana's city by leaping over the mountains and demolishing the outer gates, other boundaries, archways and other buildings they will get into Lanka city."
translations.hindi: अब किसी प्रकार समुद्र के पार करना चाहिए और ब्योंही समुद्र के पार पहुँचे कि, समझ लीजिए लङ्का वानरों दरो फतह हुई

verses.sloka: नीलः सेना पतिः चैव बल शेषेण किम् तव ।प्लवमाना हि गत्वा ताम् रावणस्य महापुरीम् ॥६-३-३२॥।।
verses.transliteration: nīlaḥ senā patiḥ caiva bala śeṣeṇa kim tava ।plavamānā hi gatvā tām rāvaṇasya mahāpurīm ॥6-3-32॥।।

translations.english: "Raghava What do we have to do with the rest of the army when Angada, Dwivida, Mainda, Jambavan, Panasa, Nala and the chief of the army Nila are there? Reaching Ravana's city by leaping over the mountains and demolishing the outer gates, other boundaries, archways and other buildings they will get into Lanka city."
translations.hindi: अङ्गद, द्विविद, मेन्द, जाम्वबान, पनस, नल और सेनापति नील ही वहाँ के लिए पर्याप्त हैं और|सेना का काम ही क्या है

verses.sloka: सप्रकाराम् सभवनाम् आनयिष्यन्ति मैथिलीम् ।सप्राकाराम् सभवनामानयुष्यन्ति राघव ॥६-३-३३॥।।
verses.transliteration: saprakārām sabhavanām ānayiṣyanti maithilīm ।saprākārām sabhavanāmānayuṣyanti rāghava ॥6-3-33॥।।

translations.english: "Raghava What do we have to do with the rest of the army when Angada, Dwivida, Mainda, Jambavan, Panasa, Nala and the chief of the army Nila are there? Reaching Ravana's city by leaping over the mountains and demolishing the outer gates, other boundaries, archways and other buildings they will get into Lanka city."

verses.sloka: एवम् आज्ञापय क्षिप्रम् बलानाम् सर्व सम्ग्रहम् ।मुहूर्तेन तु युक्तेन प्रस्थानमभिरोचय ॥६-३-३४॥
verses.transliteration: evam ājñāpaya kṣipram balānām sarva samgraham ।muhūrtena tu yuktena prasthānamabhirocaya ॥6-3-34॥

translations.english: "You may command the total army this way."Quickly start at an opportune time towards Lanka (said Hanuman to Rama)" commanded Hanuman." ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेतृतीयस्सर्गः।। This is the end of the third Sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic, the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
